name: RETTERVR
summary:
RETTERVR is a virtual reality training solution for fire departments and emergency services. The application enables realistic training of operational scenarios – especially in the field of technical rescue – within an immersive and controlled environment.
Users train typical incident situations such as traffic accidents, assess scenes, carry out measures, and make decisions under time pressure. In addition to technical procedures, communication and team coordination are a key focus.
